items.title: Edible Garden expands Walmart distribution for fresh herbs across the Mid-Atlantic
items.summary: Edible Garden AG Incorporated (NASDAQ:EDBL) is broadening its partnership with Walmart by expanding distribution of its fresh cut herbs to additional stores throughout the Mid-Atlantic region. The company said the enlarged distribution program is scheduled to begin shipping products during the third quarter of 2026, increasing the availability of its fresh herb range to consumers across the region.

items.title: Walmart (WMT) Launches 40,000 Acre Regenerative Agriculture Effort With General Mills And ADM
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT), General Mills and ADM are working together on a new regenerative agriculture program. The initiative covers 40,000 Midwest wheat acres with goals tied to soil health, water quality and carbon sequestration. The collaboration is designed as a model for broader industry change across food and retail supply chains. items.title: Back to School Spending Expected to Set Records as Shoppers Hunt for Bargains
items.summary: Kids are heading back to the classroom, and the retailer trade group expects spending on supplies to hit a record $146.8 billion, more than Mother’s and Father's Day, Easter, and the Super Bowl combined.
